summary: Firefox now supports CMYK color spaces (the color model used for printing) in its graphics library, with **accelerated SIMD implementations** across different processor architectures to make color format conversions fast. The work also brings various optimizations to image processing—swizzling operations (rearranging color components) now use efficient processor-specific code paths for SSE2, SSSE3, AVX2, and NEON, and improved algorithms like AVX2-accelerated convolution filtering for sharper image scaling.
